text:
I am your voice, warmth of your breath,

the reflection of all your faces,

useless is the beating of the useless wing:

I will be with you until the very end.


And for that reason you love me avidly,

with all my sins and weaknesses,

and for that reason you delivered to me without looking

the best of all your sons,

and for that reason you did not ask me

about that son even once,

and you filled with the smoke of praises

my house already forever empty.

And they say it is no longer possible to unite more closely

and that more irreversibly one cannot love...

As the shadow wants to separate from the body,

as the flesh wants to separate from the soul,

so I desire that you forget me.

translation.title: For Many
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the collective address and the bitter wish to be forgotten.
